value.text: Our strategy is to deliver insights and experiences that make us essential to investor workflow.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our strategy is to deliver insights and experiences that make us essential to investor workflow. Proprietary data sets, meaningful analytics, independent research, and effective investment strategies are at the core of the powerful digital solutions that investors across our client segments rely on.

value.text: Deliver differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors

strategic_priorities.quote:
We are currently focused on the following four strategic priorities:
Deliver differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors

value.text: Leverage advances in AI to drive innovation across internal and external products and services

strategic_priorities.quote:
Leverage advances in AI to drive innovation across internal and external products and services
Morningstar has always been at the forefront of technology, and we believe that AI is a significant technology that will redefine the investment landscape.

value.text: Drive operational excellence and scalability to support growth targets

strategic_priorities.quote:
Drive operational excellence and scalability to support growth targets
Morningstar has grown significantly in the last few years, and as we have continued to focus on growth in 2023 and beyond, we are emphasizing execution and scalability in our operations, processes, and technology.

value.text: Build an inclusive culture that drives exceptional talent engagement and development

strategic_priorities.quote:
Build an inclusive culture that drives exceptional talent engagement and development
Morningstar’s people and culture strategy is centered on providing a focused and differentiated approach to human capital driven by business needs.

value.text: A key aspect of our growth strategy is to expand our investment and credit research capabilities and enhance our existing products and services.

strategic_priorities.quote: A key aspect of our growth strategy is to expand our investment and credit research capabilities and enhance our existing products and services. We strive to adopt new technology that can improve our products and services.

value.text: New strategic structure that more tightly connects Morningstar Indexes with Morningstar Sustainalytics

strategic_priorities.quote: In 2023, Morningstar announced a new strategic structure that more tightly connects the index capabilities of Morningstar Indexes with the ESG data, ratings, and research of Morningstar Sustainalytics.

value.text: Realizing returns on several years of accelerated investments to drive growth

strategic_priorities.quote: In 2023, we were focused on realizing returns on several years of accelerated investments to drive growth, with improving market conditions in most parts of the business.

value.text: Focusing Morningstar Wealth on areas where we have the greatest confidence we can win — the international wealth platform and model portfolios on third-party platforms in the US — trading growth for a shorter path to profitability

strategic_priorities.quote: We are now focusing on areas where we have the greatest confidence that we can win, including our international wealth platform, which is growing rapidly, and model portfolios distributed on third-party platforms in the US. We will trade some overall growth that we might have experienced, but the cost commitment is lower and the path to profitability shorter and clearer.

value.text: Using 2024 to reset Morningstar Sustainalytics, rebuild the climate offering for European regulatory use cases, and bolster talent

strategic_priorities.quote: We are using 2024 to reset and lay a foundation for renewed growth. That includes rebuilding our climate offering—particularly to meet regulatory use cases in Europe, where we have had some recent sales wins—and bolstering talent by adding Morningstar veterans to the team.

value.text: AI: remove friction for clients and colleagues; AI adoption added as a companywide goal for 2024

strategic_priorities.quote: We’ve added AI adoption as a companywide goal for 2024, ensuring that we are at the forefront of leveraging technology and innovating responsibly in all aspects of our business.

value.text: Limit hiring and discretionary expenses in 2024 to continue improving profitability

strategic_priorities.quote: Our goal remains to limit hiring and discretionary expenses in 2024 to continue improving profitability.

value.text: Prioritize debt repayment and financial flexibility, consistent with a historically conservative balance-sheet approach

strategic_priorities.quote: During 2023, we prioritized debt repayment. We reduced debt by $137.2 million and lowered our financial covenant debt/EBITDA ratio to 1.7 times from 2.2 times as of year-end 2022.

value.text: Company Goal 1: Delivering differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors

strategic_priorities.quote: Delivering differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors.

value.text: Company Goal 2: Establishing leading ESG positions across each business

strategic_priorities.quote: Establishing leading ESG positions across each business. We first shared this corporate goal with you in our 2020 annual report, and we’re pleased with our progress since then.

value.text: Company Goal 3: Driving operational excellence and scalability to support growth

strategic_priorities.quote: Driving operational excellence and scalability to support growth. The work we do to support this goal often happens behind the scenes as we build critical infrastructure to support our future growth.

value.text: Company Goal 4: Building an inclusive culture that supports exceptional talent

strategic_priorities.quote: Building an inclusive culture that supports exceptional talent. My colleagues are central to all that we do and have been essential to what we’ve accomplished since our founding.

value.text: Expanding opportunities in private and venture market transparency, credit ratings competition, and personalization

strategic_priorities.quote: We see a similar opportunity to make investing more transparent in private and venture markets, to bring competition to the credit ratings market, and to drive a heightened level of personalization in investing.

segments.quote: We operate our business through five reportable segments: Morningstar Data and Analytics, PitchBook, Morningstar Wealth, Morningstar Credit, and Morningstar Retirement.
We operate our business through five reportable segments: Morningstar Data and Analytics, PitchBook, Morningstar Wealth, Morningstar Credit, and Morningstar Retirement.

Morningstar Wealth brings together Investment Management, which includes our model portfolios and wealth platforms; practice and portfolio management software for registered investment advisers (RIAs) (Morningstar Office); data aggregation and enrichment capabilities (ByAllAccounts); and our individual investor platform (Morningstar.com).
Morningstar Credit provides investors with credit ratings, research, data, and credit analytics solutions that we believe contribute to the transparency of international and domestic credit markets.
Morningstar Retirement offers products designed to help individuals reach their retirement goals.
Corporate and All Other includes unallocated corporate expenses as well as financial results from Morningstar Sustainalytics and Morningstar Indexes.

value.why_notable: Recurring, distinctive philosophy statement explicitly refusing guidance — unusual among public companies.

notable_language.quote: We do not make public financial forecasts for our business because we want to avoid creating any incentives for our management team to make speculative statements about our financial results that could influence our stock price or take actions that help us meet short-term forecasts, but may not build long-term shareholder value.

value.why_notable: Unusually direct admission of missed internal growth targets in three named businesses.

notable_language.quote: These reorganizations were in part in response to slower than anticipated progress against growth targets due in part to softening demand for ESG solutions for Morningstar Sustainalytics, the impact of sharp market declines in 2022 for Morningstar Wealth, and weak credit issuance activity, especially in U.S. CMBS, for Morningstar DBRS.

value.why_notable: Explicit framing of political backlash as a business risk — a shift in how the ESG business is characterised versus prior emphasis on ESG opportunity.

notable_language.quote: The politicization of ESG-related business activities and investments has increased in recent years, particularly in the U.S. This politicization has led to the rise of anti-ESG proponents and actions

value.why_notable: Hedged concession about the Sustainalytics growth story previously described as a driver.

notable_language.quote: While still strong, revenue growth slowed across regions compared to the prior year reflecting softer demand for ESG solutions.

value.why_notable: Justifies a widening segment operating loss as deliberate investment rather than underperformance.

notable_language.quote: Expense growth was primarily driven by higher compensation costs from headcount largely added during 2022 and reflects significant investments to build out the U.S. and international wealth platforms.

value.why_notable: Self-congratulatory resilience claim appended to a discussion of adverse rate and wage pressures.

notable_language.quote: Overall, our business, balance sheet, technological infrastructure, and teams have shown resilience and flexibility navigating global macroeconomic trends.

value.why_notable: Standing mission language that recurs across years; useful baseline for detecting drift.

notable_language.quote: Our mission is to empower investor success. The investing ecosystem is complex, and navigating it with confidence requires a trusted, independent voice.

value.why_notable: Explicit stated rationale for the change in metric weighting — a shift toward profitability.

notable_language.quote: In 2022, the weighting of financial performance in the calculation of the annual incentive was 67% Adjusted Revenue and 33% Adjusted EBITDA. In 2023, we increased the plan’s focus on profitability by shifting the weighting to 50% Adjusted Revenue and 50% Adjusted EBITDA for Kunal Kapoor and Jason Dubinsky.

value.why_notable: Framing of a miss: emphasises 'robust goals' and 'strong positive growth' while conceding below-target performance.

notable_language.quote: We set robust goals under our incentive plans. In 2023, we generated strong positive growth in both Adjusted Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA, however, our performance was below our target goals.

value.why_notable: Recurring justification for CEO pay structure — low salary framed as deliberate emphasis on at-risk pay.

notable_language.quote: His salary increased by 5% to $525,000 in 2023 and remains among the lowest in the peer group to emphasize the committee’s preferred focus on variable pay.

value.why_notable: Committee defends a large equity target increase by pointing to below-median positioning.

notable_language.quote: Overall, Kunal’s 2023 target total compensation remained below the median target total compensation for the peer group and continues to place more emphasis on performance-based, at-risk compensation than our peer group.

value.why_notable: Justification of a 100% individual performance factor for the CEO despite missing financial goals, citing cost reduction.

notable_language.quote: Though the Company did not exceed its 2023 financial goals, market headwinds were managed by curtailing hiring and reducing headcount, coupled with prudent investment in growth to improve profitability.

value.why_notable: Explains a grant-timing practice designed to dampen stock price volatility effects on performance awards.

notable_language.quote: With respect to MSUs, the Compensation Committee elected to grant one-half of each NEO’s targeted value in May 2023 and the other half in November 2023 to minimize the potential effect of short-term stock price volatility on the awards.

value.why_notable: Standard justification for inaction, anchored to the 98.6% support level.

notable_language.quote: Given the significant shareholder support, the Compensation Committee did not make any changes to the Company’s executive compensation program in response to the 2023 say on pay vote.

value.why_notable: Recurring governance claim distinguishing Morningstar from typical peer practice.

notable_language.quote: We do not have employment agreements or change-in-control agreements with any of our executive officers.

value.why_notable: Long-running rationale for the Executive Chairman receiving no incentive compensation.

notable_language.quote: In consideration of his status as our principal shareholder, Joe believes that his compensation should be directly aligned with other shareholders and be realized primarily through appreciation in the long-term value of our common stock. At his request and as supported by the Compensation Committee, he did not participate in our equity or cash-based incentive programs in 2023 and his salary has been $100,000 since 2000.

value.why_notable: Committee justifies an exception to the anti-pledging stance for the founder's 1,800,000 pledged shares.

notable_language.quote: After examining these factors, the Audit Committee was satisfied that Joe possessed sufficient assets aside from his pledged Company shares to satisfy, if necessary, his indebtedness secured by those shares.

value.why_notable: Unusually direct admission of a capital-allocation mistake in Morningstar Wealth.

notable_language.quote: The investments were sizable and poorly timed, given widespread losses across equity and bond markets in 2022.

value.why_notable: 'Self-inflicted wounds' is a blunt admission of execution failure rather than blaming markets alone.

notable_language.quote: While the macro environment for ESG was a drag in the US, Morningstar Sustainalytics suffered equally from self-inflicted wounds. Our climate offering was too complex for the moment, forcing us to rework product road maps in this important growth area.

value.why_notable: Frames two years of margin compression as a 'low-water mark,' implying a turn — a claim to watch against later years.

notable_language.quote: Our adjusted operating margins in 2022 and 2023 represented a low-water mark relative to our recent history and reflected accelerated investments we’d made in 2021 and 2022, especially in headcount, as well as the headwinds I described.

value.why_notable: Recurring independence claim, notable given the same letter discloses SEC settlements at Morningstar DBRS.

notable_language.quote: We kept our research teams independent of our sales and marketing groups and weren’t afraid to take heat for ratings or analyses that didn’t paint a popular fund in the best light. That remains true to this day—our analysts call it like they see it.

value.why_notable: Regulatory settlements disclosed only as a margin quantification, with no further explanation or reason given.

notable_language.quote: Severance costs related to targeted reorganizations in certain parts of the business and two Morningstar DBRS settlements with the Securities and Exchange Commission had a 0.8% impact on operating and adjusted operating margins in 2023.

value.why_notable: Rare disclosure of a sharp deterioration in an internal culture metric, with layoffs named as the cause.

notable_language.quote: Morningstar’s average annual engagement score was 69% in 2023, a decline from 80% in 2022. We made some hard choices last year to align our team size and expense structure with the market opportunity, which affected the overall score.

value.why_notable: Careful decomposition of turnover to attribute the rise to company-initiated cuts rather than attrition.

notable_language.quote: global turnover ticked up to 22% from 19%. That increase was largely driven by involuntary turnover, with voluntary turnover dropping to 12% in 2023 from 16% in 2022.

value.why_notable: Informal, personal tone; explicit assurance the letter is not AI-written amid the AI narrative.

notable_language.quote: This is one of those pivot points that we are leaning into across the firm under the leadership of a talented team that includes Adam Wheat. Rest assured, though, that I am writing this letter myself!

value.why_notable: 'Must-have' framing for PitchBook, a recurring positioning claim, stated even as growth decelerated.

notable_language.quote: With these additions, I believe PitchBook is better positioned to serve its addressable market; it’s increasingly a must-have for professional investors.

value.why_notable: Candid acknowledgment of prior dependence on competitors, claimed as resolved.

notable_language.quote: Prior to the launch, we relied on third parties—which also happened to be our competitors—for this service. We now operate a robust, independent, and globally distributed index platform.

value.why_notable: Conversational self-aware aside typical of this CEO's letter voice.

notable_language.quote: (That’s two prouds in two sentences, but I can’t think of a better word!)

reworded.heading_now: Our business is complex and has experienced significant growth in recent years which could strain our resources and infrastructure, and if we are unable to effectively scale our operations and increase productivity, we may not be able to successfully implement our business plan.
reworded.heading_prior: Supporting our growing domestic and international operations, employee headcount and customer base could strain our resources and infrastructure, and if we are unable to scale our operations and increase productivity, we may not be able to successfully implement our business plan.

reworded.heading_now: Our acquisitions and investments in companies or technologies may not realize the expected business or financial benefits and acquisitions could prove difficult to integrate, disrupt our business, dilute stockholder value and adversely affect our operating results and the market value of our common stock.
reworded.heading_prior: Our growth has recently been derived to a significant extent from acquisitions. As we acquire and invest in companies or technologies, we may not realize the expected business or financial benefits and the acquisitions could prove difficult to integrate, disrupt our business, dilute stockholder value and adversely affect our operating results and the market value of our common stock.

reworded.heading_now: Today’s fragmented geopolitical, regulatory, and cultural world could adversely affect our ability to expand our product and service offerings.
reworded.heading_prior: Today’s fragmented geopolitical, regulatory, and cultural world could adversely affect our ability to maintain growth across our businesses.

reworded.heading_now: As a global taxpayer, we face challenges due to increasing complexities in accounting for taxes (e.g., base erosion, minimum taxes, and tax transparency), which are high priorities in jurisdictions in which we operate and could materially affect our tax obligations and effective tax rate.
reworded.heading_prior: As a global taxpayer, we face challenges due to increasing complexities in accounting for taxes (e.g., base erosion, minimum taxes, and tax transparency), which are high priorities in jurisdictions in which we operate and could materially affect our tax obligations and effective tax rate.

reworded.heading_now: Our indebtedness, could adversely affect our cash flows and financial flexibility. Our variable rate indebtedness could subject us to interest rate risk, which could cause our debt service obligations to increase significantly.
reworded.heading_prior: Our indebtedness, which has increased significantly in 2022, could adversely affect our cash flows and financial flexibility. Our variable rate indebtedness could subject us to interest rate risk, which could cause our debt service obligations to increase significantly.
